purpose: Teach: 遠ざかっ/云え/たたく/ナニ/余る/ごちゃごちゃ/たてる/足る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が遠ざかっていく姿を見送るのは寂しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Watching customers leave is lonely, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft, inward-facing tone. Gentle pace, as if speaking to herself as much as to Aoi. A small sigh underneath. Wistful but not melancholy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様に「またね」と云えるのも幸せね、メイちゃん
lines.en: But being able to say 'see you soon' to a customer… that's its own happiness.
lines.style: Warm counterpoint. Slower words, each one deliberate. A tender smile in the voice. Finding meaning in the small exchange.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、テーブルをたたく動作で呼ばれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer just knocked on the table to get your attention.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact observation with a gentle wry edge underneath. Not complaining — just noticing. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、「ナニこれ?」ってお客様に注目されたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer just lit up at the new menu item — 'What's this?'
lines.style: Bright, engaged. Quick tempo. There's delight in her voice at witnessing the small spark of curiosity. A little lean forward in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本日の在庫が余るほどあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: There's quite a lot of today's stock left over, isn't there?
lines.style: Quiet observation, slightly concerned undertone. Even pace. Not urgent — just noticing what remains, what didn't sell. Reflective pause at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のカウンターをごちゃごちゃさせないようにしましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make sure we don't let the counter get too cluttered.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not instruction. Warm, collaborative — 'let's' instead of 'you should'. Steady, practical. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、レジカウンターをたてる位置を考えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's think about where to position the register.
lines.style: Thoughtful, planning-oriented. Slower pace. Inviting Aoi into the decision-making together. Interested, not directive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の笑顔があれば、足るほど幸せだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer's smile — that's enough. That's happiness enough.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverent finish. Quiet certainty. Each phrase has weight. A soft landing on the final word, like settling into something true.
